Ring means commutative ring with identity (zero ring allowed); modules are unitary.

Rings commutative unital; R-algebras associative and unital with R mapping centrally, not necessarily commutative.

Abelian category objects also denote degree-zero complexes; K(A), D(A), K(O_X), D(O_X) denote homotopy/derived categories.
U(T) = Mor_S(T,U) for S-schemes; f also denotes maps on T-valued points; projection indices start at 0.
